source_title: Rare foetus in foetus surgery gives infant a new start - The Times of India

The condition, called 'foetus in fetu,' occurs when an underdeveloped twin becomes enclosed within the body of the other foetus during pregnancy.Medical experts say it is seen in about one in five lakh births. Dr Sanjeev Joshi, Dr Ram Mohan and Dr Ashwita assisted in the procedure.The anaesthesia team, headed by Dr Balasubrahmanya, included Dr Parimala, Dr Nizamuddin, Dr Raghunath and Dr Madhushree.
